name: Campers Cove
why: No nightly rate anywhere, read 2026-10-30: the operator's 2014 Wix site (thecovekeylargo.com: 32 sites, adults only, 'stay the night, or a year', phone 305-451-0561) posts no price, and its Reservations page promises a redirect to an online booking site but carries no booking link or engine (browser-rendered); its contact email domain camperscovekeylargo.com is a parked domain (Wayback shows parking scripts since 2020); Campendium's Last Nightly Rate is blank; RV Life avg_rate 0 (placeholder). Google Maps (4.8/8, no phone) is short of the 25-review presence bar. It also looks residential: Campendium flags full-time residents and mobile homes, MHVillage lists it as Camper's Cove Mobile Home Park, and a 1994 manufactured home at 101644 Overseas Hwy unit #12 was listed for sale ($100,000, MLS A11704394), so long-stay tests 2 and 5 would also be in doubt.

name: Captain Jax RV Resort and Marina
kind_of_no: duplicate of Kings Kamp (one operation); own lots are a mobile-home community with no posted nightly rate
why: kingskamp.com/captain-jax/ (read 2026-10-30): 'Captain Jax is located right next door to Kings Kamp RV park. We offer 55 sites, Marina and boat ramp', with Kings Kamp's phone 305-451-0010 and email and no rate or booking of its own. The joint map (KK-CJ-Map PDF) splits the property with a line into two lot series, 1-55 north (Captain Jax) and 1-60 south (Kings Kamp), around one shared office, and the 2026 joint rules head both addresses (103620/103650). Kings Kamp's rate table covers only its own lots 1-60. MHVillage lists Captain Jax Trailer Resort as a 24-site mobile home park, and an active MLS listing (A12015690) sells a 1981 mobile home in 'Captain Jax Mobile' with association approval and the land not conveying. 2024-11 orthophoto shows the north half mostly roofed-over mobile homes. The RV nights sold here are Kings Kamp's, already in results/kings-kamp.json.
